title: Numbers and decimals
objective: Work with whole numbers and decimals, and turn text into a number.

body.text: A number is a whole number, such as 4. A decimal can have fractions, such as 2.5. When you do arithmetic with both, the answer is a decimal. Lagom does this for you, so you never have to convert a whole number to a decimal yourself.

body.title: Multiply a decimal
body.code:
make price equal to 2.5
make total equal to price times 2
say "Total: {total}"

body.text: Text such as "42" is not a number until you convert it. number from reads the text and gives back a number. It can fail, for example on "4x", so the conversion goes inside an attempt. The if it fails branch runs when the text is not a number.

body.title: Read a number from text
body.code:
attempt number from "42" if it fails then
    say "not a number"
otherwise
    say result
attempt number from "4x" if it fails then
    say "not a number"
otherwise
    say result

body.prompt: answer holds the text 21. Turn it into a number, double it, and print 42. If the text is not a number, print not a number.
body.solution:
make answer equal to "21"
attempt number from answer if it fails then
    say "not a number"
otherwise
    say result times 2
